name: Validate API Server Container
description: Validate Metabob API server Docker container configuration (service health, endpoints, database connectivity)

tasks.description: Check API server container status (running, healthy, uptime)

prompt.template:
Check the Docker container status for Metabob API server:

1. Run: docker ps --filter name=api-server --format '{{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.State}}'
2. Check logs: docker logs api-server --tail 50
3. Report:
   - Container state (running/stopped)
   - Health status
   - Uptime duration
   - Recent log entries
   - Any startup errors

Provide a clear status summary.

tasks.description: Verify API server health endpoint responds

prompt.template:
Verify API server health endpoint:

1. Run: curl -f http://localhost:8080/health || echo "Health endpoint failed"
2. Run: curl -f http://localhost:8080/api/health || echo "API health endpoint failed"
3. Check:
   - HTTP status code (200 OK expected)
   - Response body
   - Response time
4. Report:
   - Health status (healthy/unhealthy)
   - Endpoint URL that worked
   - Response details
   - Any errors

Provide health check verification summary.

tasks.description: Verify API server can connect to database

prompt.template:
Verify database connectivity from API server:

1. Check logs for database connection: docker logs api-server 2>&1 | grep -i 'database\|redis\|surreal'
2. Check environment variables: docker exec api-server env | grep -i 'db\|redis\|surreal'
3. Report:
   - Database type detected
   - Connection status (connected/failed)
   - Connection string (redacted)
   - Any connection errors

Provide database connectivity summary.

tasks.description: Verify API server network connectivity to other containers

prompt.template:
Verify network connectivity from API server:

1. Check Docker network: docker network inspect metabob-network | grep api-server
2. Test Redis: docker exec api-server ping -c 2 redis || echo "Redis unreachable"
3. Test SurrealDB: docker exec api-server ping -c 2 surrealdb || echo "SurrealDB unreachable"
4. Report:
   - Network name
   - Redis connectivity (reachable/unreachable)
   - SurrealDB connectivity (reachable/unreachable)
   - Any network issues

Provide network connectivity summary.

Test API server endpoints:

1. Test version endpoint: curl -s http://localhost:8080/api/version
2. Test activities endpoint: curl -s http://localhost:8080/api/activities | head -20
3. Report:
   - Version endpoint status
   - Activities endpoint status
   - Response format (JSON/other)
   - Any errors

Provide API endpoints test summary.

tasks.description: Generate comprehensive API server validation report

prompt.template:
Generate validation report for API server container:

Summarize all validation results:
1. Container Status: [running/stopped, healthy/unhealthy]
2. Service Health: [healthy/unhealthy, endpoint URL]
3. Database Connectivity: [connected/failed]
4. Network Connectivity: [Redis status, SurrealDB status]
5. API Endpoints: [working/failed]

Overall Assessment:
- ✅ PASS: All checks successful
- ⚠️ WARNING: Minor issues found
- ❌ FAIL: Critical issues found

Recommendations:
- List any required fixes
- Suggest improvements

Create report file: test-results/api-server-container-validation.md
